component_coverage_map_T9.burst_structure: ONE pulse. No precursor is reported in ANY of the 13 circulars. GBM T90 = 48.577 +/- 0.916 s starting at T05 = +9.920 s (results/grb_sample.ecsv) => T90 window 9.92 -> 58.50 s. Konus reports a main pulse with a tail to ~T0+100 s; the LAT circular claims ~100 s.
component_coverage_map_T9.so_the_T9_discriminator_here: NOT precursor-vs-main. It is (a) HOW MUCH of the single pulse a window covers, and (b) WHICH BAND — durations for this burst run 14 s (BAT 15-350 keV) to 100 s (LAT >100 MeV), a factor 7, with the HARDER band LONGER.
